# Body & Mind ON — Repo Exploration Report (Health Dashboard Context)

## 1. Next.js Router Structure

**Pages Router only** — no `app/` directory. Next.js 14.2.5, React 18.

| Category | Path | Purpose |
|----------|------|---------|
| **Main user dashboard** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\pages\profil.js` | Primary logged-in experience (~5.4k lines): plan, today panels, progress, habits, Withings |
| **Dashboard alias** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\pages\dashboard.js` | Redirects to `/profil` |
| **Admin ops** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\pages\admin.js` | `getServerSideProps` + `ADMIN_TOKEN`; body_metrics + ai_agents |
| **Auth / onboarding** | `pages/login.js`, `pages/register.js`, `pages/signup.js`, `pages/start.js`, `pages/onboarding.js` | Registration funnel |
| **Integrations** | `pages/withings-connect.js` | Withings OAuth UI |
| **Trainer** | `pages/trener.js` | Trainer signup (not a client dashboard) |
| **Marketing / tiers** | `pages/index.js`, `pages/pricing.js`, `pages/club.js`, `pages/vip.js`, `pages/on-club.js`, `pages/chci-vip.js` | LP / pricing |
| **Community** | `pages/komunita.js`, `pages/komunita/tema/[id].js` | Forum |
| **Plan share** | `pages/plan/[id].js` | Public/shared plan view |
| **Beta** | `pages/beta.js` | Beta cohort entry |

**Middleware** (`c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\middleware.js`):
- Marketing host (`bodyandmindon.cz`) → redirects app paths (`/profil`, `/dashboard`, `/start`, etc.) to `app.bodyandmindon.cz`
- App host root `/` → `/login?redirect=/profil`

**API routes** (~80+ under `pages/api/`): profile, body-metrics, withings/*, workouts, habits, AI scheduler, cron jobs, Stripe, community, trainer/clients.

---

## 2. Supabase Client Patterns

### Two clients

| Client | File | Key | Usage |
|--------|------|-----|-------|
| **Browser** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\lib\supabaseClient.js` | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Auth only (`getSession`, `signIn`, `signUp`, `signOut`). Stub when env missing. |
| **Server** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\lib\supabaseServer.js` | `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | All API routes, AI pipeline, crons. Lazy Proxy init; validates key ≠ anon/publishable. |

**No `@supabase/ssr` / no user-scoped server client.** RLS is not passed via Supabase session on the server.

### Auth + data access pattern (API routes)

Standard flow in e.g. `pages/api/profile.js`, `pages/api/body-measurements.js`, `pages/api/my-metrics.js`:

1. Client sends `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (from `supabase.auth.getSession()`).
2. Server: `supabaseServer.auth.getUser(token)` → `user.id`.
3. Server queries with **service role**, manually scoped: `.eq('user_id', user.id)`.

**Client components do not call `supabase.from()`** — data flows through `/api/*` + `fetch` (see `hooks/useProfileData.js` → `lib/profileApi.js`).

### RLS in DB

Defined in `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\supabase\migrations\20260714180000_baseline_schema.sql`:
- User-owned tables: `body_measurements`, `apple_health_*` — `auth.uid() = user_id` policies for `authenticated`.
- AI/ops tables (`ai_tasks`, `ai_messages`, `ai_trigger_rules`, `trainer_alert_state`) — RLS enabled, server-only access pattern (see migration `20260429112110_rls_server_only_tables.sql` referenced in grep).

**Types:** `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\lib\database.types.ts` (generated schema).

---

## 3. AI Agents Pattern

### Architecture (documented)

`c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\docs\AI_RUNTIME_FLOW.md` — production flow:

```
user event → ai_events → ai_trigger_rules / aiDecisionEngine
  → ai_tasks → aiScheduler → taskExecutors → runAgent / unifiedPlanPipeline
  → ai_messages (coach) / ai_generated_plans (trainer)
```

### Key tables

| Table | Role | Schema ref |
|-------|------|------------|
| `ai_tasks` | Job queue: `agent_slug`, `task_type`, `status`, `payload`, `idempotency_key` | `lib/database.types.ts` ~L1292 |
| `ai_messages` | Coach output: `content`, `task_type`, `delivery_channel` | ~L1166 |
| `ai_trigger_rules` | DB-driven triggers → task creation | Migration `20260315_ai_governance_db_first.sql`, baseline ~L1580 |
| `trainer_alert_state` | Key/value ops state (rate-limit alerts) | baseline ~L2791 |
| `ai_events` | Event queue for autonomy | `lib/aiEvents.js` |
| `ai_agents` | Agent config (model, prompts) | `pages/admin.js`, `lib/getAgentConfig.js` |

### Core lib files

| File | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| `lib/createInitialAITasks.js` | Post-registration: `trainer/initial_plan` + `coach/onboarding_message` |
| `lib/aiDecisionEngine.js` | `evaluateUserState()` — reads `ai_trigger_rules`, hardcoded fallback |
| `lib/aiEvents.js` | `enqueueAIEvent`, `processPendingAIEvents` |
| `lib/createAITasksFromDecisions.js` | Decisions → `ai_tasks` inserts |
| `lib/aiScheduler.js` | Claims & runs pending tasks; stale recovery |
| `lib/taskExecutors.js` | **Central dispatcher** `executeAITask()` → trainer/coach/marketing/validator |
| `lib/runAgent.js` | OpenAI Responses API for coach (and legacy agents) |
| `lib/buildAgentContext.js` | Context: body_metrics, plans, habits, memory |
| `lib/agentPromptsForSync.js` | Source-of-truth prompts (code, not DB) |
| `lib/aiTaskRegistry.js` | Task type schemas (DB-first `ai_task_types` + JS fallback) |
| `lib/unifiedPlanPipeline.js` | Deterministic plan generation (not OpenAI trainer) |

### API entry points

- `pages/api/ai/run-scheduler.js` — cron: `generateAITasks` → `processAIEvents` → `runAIDecisionEngine` → `runAIScheduler` (CRON_SECRET)
- `pages/api/ai/run-coach-scheduler.js` — coach-only batch
- `pages/api/ai/route.js` — ad-hoc `routeAIRequest(action)` via `lib/agentRouter.js`
- `pages/api/body-metrics.js` — registration triggers `createInitialAITasks` + plan execution

### `trainer_alert_state` usage

- `pages/api/cron/daily-digest.js` — rate-limits trainer calendar alert emails (`last_trainer_calendar_alert`)
- `pages/api/auth/google-calendar/callback.js` — clears alert on successful connect

---

## 4. Edge Functions

**Single function:** `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\supabase\functions\apple-health-ingest\`

- **Runtime:** Deno (`deno.json` alongside)
- **Auth:** `x-api-key` header → SHA-256 hash lookup in `apple_health_connections` (`verify_jwt = false`)
- **Client:** `createClient` with `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- **Flow:** POST JSON from iOS "Health Auto Export" → slim payload → `apple_health_raw_payloads` → upsert:
  - `apple_health_metrics` (idempotent: `user_id, metric_name, measured_at`)
  - `apple_health_sleep`
  - `apple_health_workouts`
- **Views:** `apple_health_metrics_daily`, `apple_health_daily`, `apple_health_recovery` (in baseline schema)

No other Edge Functions in repo.

**Apple Health has full ingest pipeline but no UI or Next.js API consumer yet** — only Edge Function + DB views. Withings and manual measurements are surfaced in `/profil`.

## 8. `lib/` Organization

~240 files. **Domain modules at root** + focused subdirs:

| Subdir | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `lib/services/` | External integrations: `planOrchestrator.js`, `wgerService.js`, `exerciseProviderRegistry.js` |
| `lib/withings/` | Withings normalization, trends, recommendations |
| `lib/registration/` | Registration-specific body metrics |
| `lib/validation/` | Plan/onboarding validators |
| `lib/nutrition/` | Portion scaling |
| `lib/plan/` | Structured plan source |
| `lib/profile/` | Profile-specific helpers (e.g. HTML repair) |
| `lib/email/` | Email design tokens |
| `lib/templates/` | HTML email templates |
| `lib/utils/` | e.g. Czech vocative |
| `lib/_archive/` | Deprecated email/plan versions |

**Naming patterns:**
- `*Server.js` — server-only (Withings, Supabase)
- `*Api.js` — client fetch wrappers (`profileApi.js`)
- `weeklyPlanEmailV*.js` — versioned email renderers
- AI cluster: `ai*.js`, `runAgent.js`, `taskExecutors.js`, `unifiedPlanPipeline.js`

**Hooks** (outside `lib/`): `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\hooks\useProfileData.js`, `usePlanStatus.js`

## 9. Existing Dashboard Pages as Reference

### Primary: `/profil` (`pages/profil.js`)

Orchestrates:
- `hooks/useProfileData` + `hooks/usePlanStatus`
- `components/profile/ProfileTodayPanels.js` — today meals/workout
- `components/profile/ProfileProgressSection.js` — health progress
- `components/profile/WithingsBodyDevelopmentSection.js`
- `components/PlanViewer.js` (dynamic, no SSR)
- `components/HabitTracker.js`, overlays (`WorkoutOverlay`, `PreferencesOverlay`)
- Paywalls: `TrialExpiredPaywall`, `PlanLockedPaywall`

Data: single `GET /api/profile` aggregates metrics, plans, workouts, habits, coach messages, Withings flag, body_measurements.

### Secondary references

| Page | Path | Pattern |
|------|------|---------|
| Dashboard redirect | `pages/dashboard.js` | Simple `router.replace('/profil')` |
| Admin | `pages/admin.js` | SSR `getServerSideProps` + `supabaseServer` direct queries |
| Trainer client list | `pages/api/trainer/clients.js` | Trainer-gated API (env `TRAINER_EMAIL`) |
| Plan view | `pages/plan/[id].js` | Read-only plan display |

## Implications for a New Health Dashboard

1. **Follow Pages Router** — add `pages/health.js` or extend `profil.js` / `components/profile/`.
2. **Data via API + Bearer token** — mirror `body-measurements.js` / `profile.js`; use `supabaseServer` + `getUser(token)`.
3. **Apple Health ready in DB** — consume `apple_health_metrics_daily`, `apple_health_sleep`, `apple_health_workouts` views; no UI exists yet.
4. **Reuse progress stack** — `lib/progressIntegrity.js` + `ProfileProgressSection` patterns.
5. **Match visual system** — `lib/designTokens.js` + `globals.css` variables, not Tailwind/shadcn.
6. **AI hooks available** — `buildAgentContext` already loads body_metrics; `ai_trigger_rules` can react to health events via `ai_events` pipeline.
7. **Testing** — add `scripts/verify-health-dashboard.mjs` (Playwright pattern used elsewhere).
